title: Independent fixed-founder capacity intervention and complementary founder-dose contrast

originating_observation.known_confounding: Previous comparison simultaneously switched 8 to 48 founders and capacity 8 to 48; regime index was also included in future RNG seed.

extinct_source_policy: Retain source if t400 has fewer than eight or zero survivors; cap the sampled count at available N, and never select on survival. Document realized founder N per source.

paired_future_randomness.limitation: After population trajectories diverge, shared RNG seed does not make every individual-level demographic draw identical.
paired_future_randomness.legacy_runner_not_usable_unmodified: scripts/chapter2_order_postshock_runner.py::paired_streams seeds by regime index; new runner must explicitly remove that component while preserving independent seed partitioning across histories and other frozen axes.

estimands.schedule_assignment: A_first_minus_I_first within each setting/history/future and regime/gate
estimands.primary_interpretation: causal model-conditional capacity effect on seed-viability sensitivity when the same eight founder genotypes are used
estimands.secondary_interpretation: joint founding-abundance and sampled-genotype effect at fixed capacity; NOT pure genetic diversity effect
estimands.multiplicity: Only the primary capacity contrast is a confirmatory decision; secondary founder-dose and subgroup analyses are descriptive.

authentication_gates: Unique previously unused visitor-history identifiers and independent fresh full-diploid prehistory
All 2048 authenticated complete t400 genotypes and survival-independent source admission
Identical selected eight founder genotype IDs and allele hashes in both capacity arms for each assigned source
No initial population size exceeding carrying capacity; no hidden thinning
Identical future stream seeds across regime and postzygotic gates at initialization; separation across visitor-history clusters
Source protocol and biology SHA-256 locked before production
Exactly 84 complete futures per t400 source and 172032 full-cohort future records before outcome readout
Baseline parity, factor-specific self-half only at postzygotic stage and no modification of pollen export
Fail closed on missing shard, nonfinite occupancy, duplicate branch, incompatible source or failed checksum
No future simulation from tests, PR CI or preflight; explicit separately approved production execution only
interpretation_limits: A new independently generated visitor-history cohort is mandatory to earn a fresh confirmatory label.
Capacity-specific effect is conditional on eight selected founders and on the model's seeded demography, not a natural island threshold.
The founder-dose secondary contrast changes founder abundance and genomic sampling together; it does not identify diversity alone.
Previously observed synthetic results are hypothesis generation, not additional independent evidence.
Local terminal occupancy is not lifetime plant fitness, natural genetic mediation or a field-calibrated Izu extinction result.
Sample size 64 is fixed before outcomes; an inconclusive result remains inconclusive.
